dossier.scp_unleashed.076.title: Abel
dossier.scp_unleashed.076.caption: SCP-076-1 as first sighted: a black stone cube, its door facing the camera.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-076-1 cannot be moved, damaged or flooded. Its door is to be watched from a distance at all times.
**No one is to open the door of SCP-076-1.** If its locks are seen turning, all personnel are to withdraw at once.
An active SCP-076-2 is to be engaged only by a full response team. No one is to shelter inside SCP-076-1. %rTeams that did so were not recovered.%r

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-076-1 is a cube of black stone about nine metres on each side, standing alone in open country. No tool, blast or flood has ever marked it.

One face holds a stone door bound by seven locks, each marked with a red sign. When the door is tried, the locks turn one by one and the door grinds down into the ground. Inside is a single dark chamber holding a stone coffin.

SCP-076-2 rests in the coffin. It is a lean humanoid with pale grey skin and long dark hair, dressed in a torn pale robe and covered in a web of faintly glowing red markings. Once released it hunts any person it finds with a great hooked blade of black metal, and throws smaller knives of the same metal. It has struck down targets well out of its reach. %rDistance is no defence.%r
SCP-076-2 is extremely durable and heals when left alone.

page.title: Addendum 076-1: Recovery
text: SCP-076-1 was found after a survey team noted a dark shape where none had been recorded. All seven locks were set.
The first team to open it lost four of six members. The survivors reported that the door had closed again behind them.

page.title: Addendum 076-2: Observation Log
text: After every release, SCP-076-1 has later been found sealed, with SCP-076-2 back in its coffin. For some time afterwards the locks will not turn. %rThe length of this period is unconfirmed.%r
SCP-076-2 does not speak. Once it stopped to listen before turning toward a hidden observer.
The red signs on the door glow brightest while all seven locks are set.

SCP-076-2 is a lean humanoid with pale grey skin, long dark hair and a web of red markings that glow faintly in the dark. He wears a torn pale robe and fights with a great hooked blade of black metal.
He hunts any person he notices, players and D-Class alike, and he runs faster than most people can. Up close he cuts; further away, he throws.
Keeping your distance is not the same as being safe. Watch the ground under your feet.
He has %s health and heavy armour, and he recovers when he is left alone. When he is beaten, nothing of him remains but dust.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp076_vault_ston: The black stone of SCP-076-1. It cannot be broken, burned or blown apart, and pistons and endermen cannot move it.
Water and lava cannot wear it away, and nothing spawns on it.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp076_vault_door: The only way into SCP-076-1: a stone door three blocks wide and four tall, held shut by seven locks.
Try the door to test the locks. When they turn, the door grinds open and whatever rests inside is free.
It cannot be broken, pushed or flooded. It has been seen to close again by itself.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp076_coffin.1: The stone sarcophagus at the heart of SCP-076-1. Its lid cannot be lifted by hand.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp076_coffin.2: It is never empty for long.
